item.title: American Fork man concerned city code changes could limit property development
item.description: An American Fork man is voicing concerns over changes to the city's code that he says will limit his ability to build on his property.

item.title: Utah licensed acupuncturists concerned proposed bill could threaten patient safety
item.description: Reaching the level of expertise required to perform acupuncture demands a unique balance, striking the right amount of training and testing. And that “balance” is being threatened by House Bill 202.

item.title: Utah lawmakers look to make additional steps in vetting 'sensitive materials' from school libraries
item.description: The proposed House bill would restrict how digital databases for content are handled and remove those that have been marked as violating standards, including allowing the use of AI to check the books.
